name: ClickToMoveNavigator
src_typeComment: Plug-and-play point-and-click movement — click on the ground (a real NavMesh-walkable surface) and this sends the attached NavMeshAgent there. Nothing else in this toolkit bridges a raycast to navigation — Toolkit.Grid.Placement.GridPlacer is for editor/grid-snapped PLACEMENT, not moving an existing agent.

src_serialized.name: sourceCamera
src_serialized.tooltip: Defaults to Camera.main if left empty.

src_serialized.name: mouseButton
src_serialized.tooltip: 0 = Left click, 1 = Right click, 2 = Middle click.

src_members.name: MoveTo
src_members.comment: Public so a click can be driven from anywhere (a UI button, a controller's face button acting on the current reticle target) instead of only a literal mouse click — and so this is testable without needing a real click/raycast.
